title: Reduce complete selected-baseline time by 33.67% (no κ)
body:
## Summary

The complete captured PR6030 selected-baseline command takes **33.67% less median wall time locally**, with identical complete output and all 1,405 manifest files still opened and hashed. Claim type: scoped implementation-equivalence proof, exact conformance checks and local performance evidence. No new kappa, scientific audit, supplier admission or selected-frontier change.

```diff
 explicit_file
-  traverse every directory for every manifest name
-  resolve the leaf and root again
+  validate each shared directory prefix once per invocation
   check every leaf; open and hash every file
```

Only the separate `research/selected-prefix-authentication/` package is added. The source checker and report projection execute from their pinned original source files. Shared scripts, predecessor credits and scientific inputs retain their bytes. The proof assumes a stable POSIX checkout during each invocation; no cache crosses invocations.

Credit Mihir Srivastava / mihir-s-05, PR4463, for the productive-helper baseline, Douglas Colkitt and the retained checker contributors, and the complete PR6030/native/caller/compiler lineage. Arham Tahir / Arham-Tahir64's merged PR2793 already reuses resolved paths in the later primary-proof membership pass. That separate pass is untouched here; no comparison against or replay of the earlier candidate is claimed. Prefix memoization is classical. This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas.

## Evidence

- Before: official-command median 0.191614750 s, range 0.188641834–0.202052708 s.
- After: adapter median 0.127094625 s, range 0.126506333–0.136955000 s.
- Five alternating fresh-process pairs, CPython 3.12.15 / macOS 27.0.1 arm64, warm OS caches. Zero errors; all ten complete stdout SHA256 values equal `156c34206e1cac9a535d7458ba82c57f9681faad966b45bfda433c0da57b67b8`. Samples and environment are in README.md. This is a local complete-command measurement, not a portable percentage.
- The original traversal has 7,759 component symlink checks. The adapter checks 441 distinct directories and all 1,405 leaves; it removes 5,913 repeated directory symlink checks and two redundant resolutions per explicit file. A separate untimed profile identifies this traversal as substantial work; reading and SHA256 remain.
- Normal and optimized registered checks pass. They compare complete reports, all file/directory validation counts, 52 path cases, seven corruption/alias/invalidation controls and three capacity/fallback controls. The two registered commands took 0.564 s and 0.418 s locally, well below their 120-second limits.
- All 13 inherited baseline report tests pass. Exact committed-byte/source-history preflight passes for all 1,417 package/input files at publication head `8e56b45f42b2ed54b8ca600ac8d5f5cc5f6b4e6c`.
- Official committed export and integrity checks pass. Normal and optimized direct checks pass from the sealed read-only, Git-free export with an empty PATH. Every external replay input is declared. Generated receipts bind package hashes; no receipt is handwritten.

From the repository root, using the local interpreter path:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/selected-prefix-authentication/fast.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/selected-prefix-authentication/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/selected-prefix-authentication/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-prefix-authentication
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/selected-prefix-authentication --check-source-history
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/selected-prefix-authentication/benchmark.py --rounds 5
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research_selected_baseline.py -v
```

Other machines may substitute their CPython 3.12 path. Expected markers are `PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY`, `PASS_SELECTED_PREFIX_AUTHENTICATION`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

This is an opt-in implementation improvement for one captured selected record and explicit file inventory. The optimized POSIX path has at most 4,096 names and depth 128. Windows delegates to the original validator; native Windows execution and performance are untested. No atomic filesystem snapshot or concurrent-mutation guarantee is supplied. The benchmark refuses a changed current selected record.

The package authenticates sources and metadata; their scientific verifiers are not executed or audited. All five selected framework assumptions remain. No selected scientific cold replay, native suite, Lean or Docker run, physical caller saving, independent human review or formal proof-kernel acceptance is claimed. No registered command is left unrun locally.

## Open next questions

- Test full conformance and complete-command performance on Linux and Windows before a proposed maintained integration with an explicit stable-checkout contract.
- Capture a later selected record and complete source closure, then rerun the bounded controls and benchmark. Automatic migration and future schema support are not supplied.

## Related open work

- PR6319 detects stale digest pins in proposed file edits; this package preserves those files and optimizes the complete source-authentication command. It makes no new stale-pin audit or shared timing claim.
- No other open PR studying this complete baseline directory-validation time was identified in the live title/body and cached-coverage searches. Arbitrary historical diffs and unpublished work remain limits.

Completion refresh on 2026-11-03 listed all 16 open account PRs created since the CLAIM, including this PR. The other 15 study different commands or mathematical quantities. No additional same-command timing result was identified; no predecessor number was recomputed.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks, `plan` and `replay (research/selected-prefix-authentication)`, passed at exact head `8e56b45f42b2ed54b8ca600ac8d5f5cc5f6b4e6c` in [run 41634764882](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41634764882). The completed check list was read once; separate run metadata confirms `completed`, `success` and the matching head. All registered checks also passed locally. Hosted replay certifies execution of the declared finite checks, not independent proof acceptance or a portable timing percentage.

Canonical main was refreshed before submission and remains `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority revision 8. The advance claim is [here](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19373356). Remote overlap coverage reported complete pagination for 555 open PRs and 6,596 Discussion records, supplemented with live submission searches and main/merged searches; sparse local notes are incomplete.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** isolated.

Only one opt-in research package is added. Default source checking, frozen inputs and selected-frontier metadata are unchanged.
